tabs.tab1_description:
Pink Sapphire is a captivating gemstone with a variety of extraordinary properties. It is most renowned for its exquisite color, a delicate yet mesmerizing shade of rosy pink that radiates warmth and elegance. As a corundum variety, belonging to the same mineral family as rubies and sapphires, Pink Sapphire is distinguished by its remarkable hardness, making it not only a stunning adornment but also a highly durable gemstone suitable for everyday wear.

This prestigious stone is composed of corundum (aluminum oxide) and owes its natural pink hue to trace amounts of chromium. Typically found in igneous rocks and alluvial deposits, Pink Sapphire is a 9 on the Mohs scale, making it one of the hardest gemstones, surpassed only by diamonds. Its durability, coupled with its soft yet radiant glow, has made it a treasured gem throughout history.

Pink Sapphire is believed to enhance emotional balance, compassion, and wisdom, making it an ideal stone for individuals seeking deeper connections in love and relationships. It is associated with prosperity, beauty, and grace, making it a favored choice for those looking to attract abundance and harmony into their lives. Moreover, this gemstone is said to bring peace, joy, and emotional resilience, reducing stress and promoting self-love.

Pink Sapphire is ruled by Venus (Shukra), the planet of love, luxury, and artistic expression. Wearing this gem is believed to amplify Venus’s positive influence in one’s birth chart, leading to enhanced relationships, creativity, and financial success. In Vedic tradition, Pink Sapphire is also associated with Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, prosperity, and divine beauty, making it an auspicious choice for those seeking blessings in both material and spiritual realms. Additionally, this gemstone is connected to the Hrit Padma Chakra, the sacred energy center linked to divine love, inner fulfillment, and spiritual awakening.

This enchanting gemstone has long held the admiration of royalty, mystics, and seekers of beauty and wisdom. Natural Pink Sapphire has been revered by priests, healers, and spiritual guides in India since ancient times, as it is believed to facilitate a connection with higher realms of consciousness and divine grace.

In conclusion, Pink Sapphire harmonizes elegance with spiritual depth, offering the wearer a path to love, abundance, wisdom, and inner serenity. Its radiant charm and transformative properties continue to captivate hearts and enrich lives across cultures and traditions.

Other Names: Gulabi Pukhraj (Hindi), Padmaraga (Sanskrit)

Pink Sapphire Gemstone Planet: Venus (Shukra)

Vedic Rashi (Moon Sign): Taurus, Libra

Lagna (Ascendants): Taurus, Gemini, Libra, Capricorn

Pink Sapphire Zodiac Sun Sign: Libra

Pink Sapphire Gemstone Chakra: Hrit Padma Chakra

Birthstone of which Month: September
tabs.tab2_description:
Who Should Wear Pink Sapphire Gemstone?

Pink Sapphire, ruled by Venus (Shukra), is ideal for those seeking love, emotional healing, and prosperity. It is especially beneficial for individuals with a weak or strong Venus in their birth chart, enhancing relationships, creativity, and financial stability.

It is highly recommended for Taurus and Libra Moon signs and suits Taurus, Gemini, Libra, and Capricorn Ascendants. Those in art, fashion, beauty, and luxury-related professions can benefit from its influence.

Pink Sapphire is linked to the Hrit Padma Chakra, fostering love, self-acceptance, and emotional balance. It is an excellent choice for those looking to heal past wounds, attract positive relationships, and achieve inner harmony.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Pink Sapphire gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Pink Sapphire gemstones.

How many carats? 5 Carats

Which metal for the ring? Gold or Silver

Color of Pink Sapphire: Rosy Pink

Which finger to wear in: Consult Our Experts to know the correct finger

When to wear (Day and Time): Friday morning

Mantra For Pink Sapphire Stone: Om Shum Shukraya Namaha (108 Times)

Pink Sapphire Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Pink Sapphires are primarily found in Sri Lanka (Ceylon), renowned for their vibrant pink hues and exceptional clarity. Other significant sources include Madagascar, Myanmar (Burma), Thailand, and Australia, where pink sapphires are discovered in alluvial deposits. Myanmar has historically produced high-quality pink sapphires, and some deposits are also found in India.

Observe their Color:

Sri Lankan Pink Sapphires exhibit a pure, vibrant rosy pink with excellent clarity and brilliance. A highly saturated, intense pink is preferred over pale or overly dark stones. The ideal tone is medium to medium-dark, as lighter stones may appear washed out, while darker ones may lose their brilliance.

Notice their Clarity:

Pink Sapphire clarity ranges from flawless, eye-clean gemstones to stones with minor inclusions such as mineral traces or fine fractures. Transparent and inclusion-free pink sapphires are highly valued, as their clarity enhances the stone’s radiant pink hue.

Examine their Inclusions:

While some Pink Sapphires appear clear and transparent, others may contain inclusions that influence their transparency and value. Each gemstone is unique, and natural inclusions can sometimes be seen as identifiers of authenticity.

See their Shape:

Pink Sapphires are crafted in various shapes to highlight their brilliance. Round and oval cuts are timeless and elegant, while cushion and pear cuts emphasize their soft, romantic hue. Princess and emerald cuts offer a modern, structured look, while heart-shaped Pink Sapphires exude a romantic charm.

Check the Carats:

Pink Sapphires are cut and polished into various carat weights. A 5-carat Pink Sapphire is ideal for jewelry. Since gemstones are priced per carat, higher carat weight and clarity increase the value significantly.

Avoid Heated & Treated Pink Sapphire:

Heat-treated Pink Sapphires lose their natural energy and healing properties. To ensure maximum spiritual and astrological benefits, only natural, untreated gemstones should be worn.

Check for Lab Certificate:

It is crucial to buy Pink Sapphires with a lab-certified authenticity report confirming their origin and natural composition. Rudra Centre has been offering untreated, unheated, and lab-certified gemstones for 25 years, with certifications from GIA, IGI, GLI, and IGITL.

Why buy Pink Sapphire from Rudra Centre?

We provide only natural, untreated, and unheated gemstones, carefully sourced and energized according to Vedic Vidhi. With 100,000+ satisfied customers, our gemstones are chosen for their purity and effectiveness.

Can I give my used Pink Sapphire to someone else?

If you have worn the Pink Sapphire, it is not advisable to give it to someone else. However, if unused for an extended period, you may pass it on after a minimum two-week gap and by performing a proper cleansing and re-energizing ritual as recommended in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
Pink Sapphire Quality & Price

It is highly recommended to wear only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Pink Sapphire gemstones. According to Vedic scriptures, any form of heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, reducing its spiritual and astrological benefits.

The quality of Pink Sapphire is determined by the four Cs:

Color

Pink Sapphires range from delicate pastel pink to deep magenta. The most sought-after shades are pure, vibrant pink with a high level of saturation. Stones with a soft, rosé-like hue or intense pink with a violet undertone are considered the most valuable.

Cut

The best-quality Pink Sapphires are cut to maximize brilliance and clarity. Common cuts include round and oval for a classic look, cushion cuts for elegance, and pear or heart shapes for a romantic appeal.

Carat

A 5-carat or larger Pink Sapphire is considered ideal for harnessing its beauty and spiritual benefits. However, even smaller or larger stones are widely used in jewelry. The larger the carat, the higher the price, especially for stones with excellent color and clarity.

Clarity

Pink Sapphires can have minor inclusions, but the most valuable ones are eye-clean, meaning they have no visible flaws. Completely flawless Pink Sapphires are exceptionally rare and highly prized.

Beware of Heated & Treated Pink Sapphire

Many Pink Sapphires in the market are heated or color-enhanced to improve appearance. However, treated stones lose their natural healing properties. Always choose untreated Pink Sapphire for maximum astrological and spiritual benefits.

Buy from a Trusted Source

Since treated Pink Sapphires are common, it is crucial to purchase only from reputed dealers with certification from recognized gemological labs.

Pink Sapphire Gemstone Price

The price of Pink Sapphire varies based on carat size, color, clarity, and origin.

  • Color: Vibrant and highly saturated pink commands the highest price.
  • Clarity: Eye-clean stones are more valuable than those with visible inclusions.
  • Origin: Pink Sapphires from Sri Lanka (Ceylon) and Madagascar are considered superior and typically cost more.
  • Treatments: Untreated, naturally vibrant Pink Sapphires are significantly more expensive than heat-treated ones.

How to Identify or Test an Authentic Pink Sapphire?

The best way to verify the authenticity of Pink Sapphire is through a lab certification from a reputed gemological institute. Rudra Centre provides certified, natural, and untreated Pink Sapphires approved for Vedic astrology.

Methods to Check if Pink Sapphire is Genuine:

  • Look for natural inclusions: Use a 10x magnification lens to check for tiny inclusions or natural mineral formations inside the gemstone.
  • Check for air bubbles: Fake Pink Sapphires (glass imitations) contain small air bubbles. A genuine stone will have no bubbles.
  • Light Reflection Test: Shine a flashlight on the gemstone. If it reflects only its natural pink hue, it is real. If it reflects multiple colors, it may be synthetic.

Pink Sapphire Cleaning & Maintenance

  • Soak the Pink Sapphire in warm, soapy water.
  • Use a soft brush (like a toothbrush) to clean dirt and oils.
  • Rinse thoroughly under running water and pat dry with a lint-free cloth.
  • Avoid harsh chemicals, ultrasonic cleaners, and steam cleaning, as these can damage the stone.
  • Regular cleaning helps maintain its brilliance and effectiveness.
